venues.name: Pestana Palace Lisboa
venues.capacity: Up to 230 guests (Doug's notes); Valle Flôr exclusive up to 320
venues.notes: Hotel venue with in-house catering; guests can stay on site.

venues.name: Queluz National Palace
venues.style: Rococo / Baroque royal palace, French formal gardens
venues.capacity: Throne Room 200 seated / 230 standing; Robillion terraces & gardens 280
venues.venuePrice: Planner packages for 50 guests: €36,000 (gardens + Robillion terrace) to €43,000 (+ Throne Room), +VAT
venues.notes: State-run monument; catering, kitchen and lighting must all be brought in.

venues.name: Palácio de Tancos
venues.style: Historic, artistic, and adaptable; terrace with city views

venues.name: Palácio da Fonte Nova
venues.area: Sintra / Cascais area (run by Penha Longa / Ritz-Carlton)
venues.style: Elegant and romantic; 1743 palace with gardens
venues.capacity: Up to 50–150 guests (Doug's notes; no other source found)
venues.notes: 150 is at the top of its capacity.

venues.name: Palácio do Correio-Mor
venues.style: Baroque, aristocratic, and romantic; French boxwood gardens
venues.venuePrice: On request (aggregator estimate ~€45k–€110k all-in for ~100 guests)
venues.notes: Price source is an aggregator, so it's less reliable.

venues.name: Quinta da Bella Vista
venues.style: Elegant yet grounded; former home of Arthur Conan Doyle
venues.capacity: Up to 200 guests (Doug's notes); Wezoree lists 150

venues.name: Quinta das Torres
venues.capacity: Up to 100–250 guests (Doug's notes); casamentos.pt lists 100–350
venues.venuePrice: On request (catering only through Festa Aluga)
venues.notes: The duplicate entry in Doug's original list was actually Quinta da Nossa Senhora da Conceição (see its own entry).

venues.name: Quinta da Nossa Senhora da Conceição
venues.area: Azeitão (Canais), ~30 min from Lisbon, near the Arrábida hills
venues.style: Romantic and natural; restored 1715 Baroque manor with gardens, patios, terraces and pool
venues.capacity: 50–150 guests (Doug's notes). The venue lists 600 m² indoors, 700 m² outdoor dining, a 400–600 m² clear marquee, and a kitchen that caters for up to 300
venues.venuePrice: On request (no published price; catering through Casa do Marquês)
venues.notes: Listed by Casa do Marquês as 'Quinta da Conceição', Rua Quinta dos Canais, Azeitão. Exclusive use, one event per day, parking for 150 cars. CHECK: a different, much smaller 'Quinta de Nossa Senhora da Conceição' exists in Trafaria (Almada): a rustic ~100 m² barn with sea views, max 80 guests (https://www.casamentos.pt/quintas-para-casamentos/eventar-eventos--e170639). Compare Doug's Google Maps / Wedding Box link to confirm it's the Azeitão one.

venues.name: Quinta dos Gafanhotos
venues.style: Classic Portuguese quinta, pool and gardens
venues.notes: Cheapest on the list; mostly used by local Portuguese couples.

venues.name: Vandelli Botanical Garden
venues.capacity: Up to 250 (casamentos.pt); up to 300 (Turismo de Lisboa)
venues.venuePrice: Doug's estimate: $32,740 USD; menus from €146 per guest
venues.notes: Doug already has a wedding video link for this venue. Include it.

venues.name: Forte da Cruz
venues.capacity: 80–200 guests (Doug's notes); Cvent lists 250 seated / 500 standing
venues.notes: Very popular; books a year or more ahead.

venues.name: Herdade do Perú
venues.style: Wine estate between the Arrábida hills and the coast
venues.notes: On-site accommodation for part of the guest list.
